capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Green Cars Compare (pre-production page): "75.3 kWh usable battery pack". InsideEVs (VinFast CES 2023) says only "75.3-kWh battery pack"; Wikipedia lists "70.8 / 75.3" (the repo note says 70.8 is an Indian-market LFP pack). Gross not recorded.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: both VF 7 variants use a lithium iron phosphate battery, "capacity slightly varying by market". Market unclear (Wikipedia); no US-market chemistry source found.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: VinFast US charging page describes only app cabin pre-heat/pre-cool; no battery preconditioning for charging found on VinFast pages. No owner's manual or maker statement found; owner decision requested.

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: up to 150 kW DC for both variants. Conflict: Green Cars Compare says DC "topping out at a maximum speed of 100 kW".

ac_max_kw.notes: 11 kW on a Level 2 AC charger (pre-production page, specs may change).
